statement: Disposition of every durable decision-bearing artifact in the governed surface. Answers the inverse of the preexecution reuse check: not whether every cited source resolves, but whether anything was produced that nothing cites. DERIVED_RULE rows are recomputed from bytes on every run; EXPLICIT rows are recorded decisions. An artifact with neither is UNCLASSIFIED and blocks.
selfExclusionReason: An index cannot carry its own digest; its freshness is bound by the fast-path control plane instead.
